messages.content: Who discovered Gravity and what was the method used?

function.name: science_history_get_discovery_details
function.description: Retrieve the details of a scientific discovery based on the discovery name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

discovery.description: The name of the discovery, e.g. Gravity

method_used.description: The method used for the discovery, default value is 'default' which gives the most accepted method.

message.reasoning:
The user asks: "Who discovered Gravity and what was the method used?" They want the discoverer of gravity and the method used. Likely referencing Isaac Newton, who formulated the law of universal gravitation. The method used: observation of falling objects, planetary motion, etc. But maybe they want the method used to discover gravity: observation of falling apples, experiments with pendulums, etc. The question might be ambiguous: "Who discovered Gravity" could refer to the concept of gravity as a force. Historically, Newton is credited with discovering the law of universal gravitation. The method used: observation of falling objects, planetary motion, and mathematical derivation. So answer: Isaac Newton discovered gravity, using observation of falling apples, planetary motion, and mathematical analysis.

We can also mention that the method used was the observation of falling objects and the application of mathematics to derive the inverse-square law. So answer accordingly.
